strategy: Progressive disclosure: load the hot path first, then defer source, manifest, oracle, progress, handoff, and ledger files until a phase action requires them.

actor.notes: Do not eagerly load source-packet.md or continuity-ledger.md; load them only when code facts, evidence, or handoff writeback requires them.

critic.notes: Review actor report, changed files, validation evidence, feature oracle evidence, and minimal-change scope from a fresh context.

deferred.README.md: Do not load until broad harness orientation is missing.
deferred.phase-manifest.md: Do not load until phase index or validation matrix is needed.
deferred.source-packet.md: Only when code facts, prior evidence, or source assumptions are needed.
deferred.loop-contract.json: Only when loop semantics are unclear.
deferred.feature-oracle.json: Only when selecting or updating the active feature status/evidence/notes.
deferred.progress-log.md: Only when recording session progress, validation, or blockers.
deferred.agent-handoff.md: Only when preparing or consuming planner/generator/critic handoff.
deferred.continuity-ledger.md: Only when checking downstream contracts or writing code-summary handoff.
deferred.next-window-prompt.md: Only when preparing a fresh continuation prompt.
